_comment: PORTABLE LBVI sweep config: all paths are RELATIVE, so this works on any machine as long as everything sits in ONE folder (see README_sweep.txt). When you assemble the distribution folder, RENAME this file to sweep_config.json so 'python run_sweep.py' finds it automatically.
_jar_note: Name of the jar in this folder. Rename your built jar to RESET_LBVI.jar, OR change this line to match your jar's filename.
_base_params_note: Baseline for EVERY run (your single source of truth for all parameters), read from this folder. Precedence per run: base_params -> fixed -> swept value. Set to "" to use the model's in-code defaults instead. The input-file paths in 'fixed' below override whatever paths this baseline contains.
_seed_note: seed_per_run=true gives each run its own reproducible seed = seeds[0] + runIndex. Set false to run every seed in 'seeds' against every parameter set (cartesian).
_mode_options: one_at_a_time  : vary one parameter while all others stay at their first (baseline) value
full_factorial : run every combination of all sweep values (can be large!)
_sweep_note: Each sweep value is a list, OR {"range": [start, stop]} (stop exclusive, like Python range) / {"range": [start, stop, step]}. In one_at_a_time mode the FIRST value of each list is the baseline.
_fixed_note: These RELATIVE input paths resolve against the jar's own folder, so they work as long as RESET_LBVI_inputData sits beside the jar. To run a different beetle scenario, change beetleImpactFilePath to inBeetleImpact_SantaClaraCentral.csv or inBeetleImpact_SantaClaraEast.csv.
_heap_comment: Max JVM heap per run (-Xmx). heap x parallel_jobs must stay under total RAM, leaving a few GB for the OS.
_parallel_comment: Number of runs to execute in parallel. Set to 1 for sequential.
